title: Dashboard Monitoring Panel & Alert Gedung A & B

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "panel_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "voltage_l1_v" or
    r._field == "voltage_l2_v" or
    r._field == "voltage_l3_v"
